findings.label: force-dynamic gap in docs sub-pages
findings.description: /docs/getting-started, /docs/discord-commands, /docs/tournaments/create, and /docs/tournaments/formats have no per-file export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'. Add the export to each file to match the rest of the codebase.

findings.label: Auth-guard regression in /admin/payment/page.tsx
findings.description: The rewrite removed the server-side auth guard present on every other admin page. The payment UI frame renders before the useEffect API call returns a 401. Convert back to the server-component + client-component pattern, or add a server-rendered auth check before the client shell is sent.

findings.label: Query-cache subscription leak in OverlayClient.tsx
findings.description: queryClient.getQueryCache().subscribe() is called in the component body with no cleanup. Every re-render adds a new subscriber. Wrap in useEffect and return the unsubscribe function.

findings.label: Stale eslint-disable comment in OverlayClient.tsx
findings.description: Line 57 has eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any but the suppressed line uses Record<string, unknown> with as-casts, not any. Remove the comment.

findings.label: BracketPageClient.tsx has no framer-motion animations
findings.description: It is a 'use client' component but no entry animations were added, despite FEAT-003 implying coverage. Add motion.div wrappers to the panel entry for consistency with every other client component in the redesign.
